svg.title: Atraxis architecture
svg.desc: Atraxis reads configured Monit-Docker and CertLord APIs directly, or queries Prometheus. In the optional metrics route, Prometheus scrapes Covenant, which reads the source APIs. Atraxis calls Atropos through its independent client. Atropos submits explicitly authorized jobs to Auton and configured notifications to Alertmanager. Prometheus can also send configured metric alerts to Alertmanager. Arrows point from caller to called service; query responses return in reverse.

g.title: Atraxis crystalline eye and three-node orbit
